tells: 1. The laugh barely happens: across six frames only the woman in the white blouse lifts a hand and the rest keep the same pose and expression, so nothing reads as caused by a line or building (club-5-strip.png, all panels, front tables)

2. The back of the house is flat, uniformly grey cut-out silhouettes with no interior shading or volume, and most of them are standing still like cardboard (club-1-wide.png, upper middle band behind the front tables; club-2-mid.png, upper left)

3. Front-table resting poses repeat: hands clasped on the table near the candle for almost everyone, at the same height, which reads as one pose cloned (club-1-wide.png, front row centre-right; club-6-held.png, centre tables)

4. In the face close, a dark matte halo runs along the hair and shoulder edge against the blurred background, the skin is waxy with no pores, and the teeth and mouth are dark (club-4-face.png, head outline and right shoulder, mouth)

5. Candle cups are flat, self-lit salmon blocks that don't light the hands or faces around them, and hands sit on or in the candles (club-3-mid.png, centre table under the green hoodie; club-2-mid.png, centre table)

1. Shading breaks on the far-left figures: torsos split into flat white and black panels, a grey untextured arm on the front blonde, and faces cut by hard shadow, which reads as broken materials or LOD (theatre-6-held.png, left third, rows 1-4)
2. The back rows are stacked black cardboard silhouettes in identical upright postures that fill the whole upper frame like wallpaper (theatre-1-wide.png, top half; theatre-2-mid.png, top band)

3. The front row sits bolt upright with hands on knees, legs parallel and evenly spaced, so in the wide they look like they are standing or floating rather than sitting in seats (theatre-1-wide.png, front row centre)

4. Heads pop between frames: hair turns into a cap-like dark mass and heads snap round at t=12.8, and the laugh itself barely changes anyone's body (theatre-5-strip.png, panels t=12.6 to t=13.0, back-left man and front-right man)

5. The face close shows a gasp or grimace rather than a laugh, with dark teeth, dead glassy eyes, a dark edge halo around the hair, and earrings that don't follow the head (theatre-4-face.png, centre face and hair outline)
1. Everyone in the wide shares one pose, leaning forward with hands on knees and heads at the same height, which reads as a synced cloned rig (openmic-1-wide.png, entire front two rows)

2. Bodies clip into each other: the red-haired woman's pink legs pass through her neighbour's lap, and the blue-cap man's head drives into the man beside him (openmic-6-held.png, centre bottom around the green-top woman; left, the blue-cap man)

3. The hair has comb-like hatched aliasing, and a dark cut-out halo runs round the head and shoulder against the depth-of-field background (openmic-4-face.png, back of the hair at right and the shoulder outline)

4. Mid-row faces have blotchy black shading on the nose and mouth, and the red-jacket man's face is muddy, so they read as broken normals or cavity maps at TV distance (openmic-3-mid.png, man behind the yellow shirt at centre-left; red-jacket man at right)

5. The room has a flat ceiling with evenly spaced bloom dots and a featureless wall and floor, so the back of the house falls to near black with no believable depth or other patrons (openmic-1-wide.png, upper half and sides)
